Gotta tell you, this place is fantastic for all you pets, mascots and animal breeding needs. However, DONNOT attempt to purchase any snakes or reptile at this location. They’re ALL INFESTED WITH MITES!!! If you have a reptile or snake collection and bring home one of these snakes from  Robert’s Pet Shop, you will definitely infest your collection with mites!! These mites are tiny parasites that look like a round beetle. A fully grown snake mite will grow the size of a pinhead and they’re dark brown or black in color. They hide under the snakes scales where they feed constantly. They suck the blood of your snake and hatch all over your home. Not good. They’re really hard to eliminate completely and will eventually kill your reptiles!! You’ve been warned!!

Not a good place to buy animals. The moment they see you're interested, they raise the price. I went to buy an Amazon parrot, and a worker quoted me $1000. Then an older gentleman and the owner came and raised the price to $1500 after talking amongst themselves and realizing the parrot could speak a few words. They said the other parrots could be reduced to $1000. I left, but returned with a relative to buy two parrots, hoping for a discount. The new price was $1600, and if I bought two, they were $1400 each. The owner was incredibly greedy. I left without buying anything. I don't recommend this place; you can find better prices at other flea markets.
